geolocation_alert.title: Suomi NPP VIIRS Data Product Geolocation Anomaly - July 2024
geolocation_alert.statement: Data gaps will exist from 21:42:00 UTC on July 9, 2024, through 17:42:00 UTC on July 16, 2024, due to unrecoverable geolocation errors and invalid timestamps. Normal production resumed starting with July 16, 2024, after GPS recovery at 17:42:00 UTC. The anomaly start in the earlier notice is 21:46:00 UTC on July 9, 2024. The referenced datasets include VIIRS/NPP Active Fires 6-Min L2 Swath 375m V002.

july24_alert.title: Suomi NPP VIIRS Data Product Anomaly - July 2024
july24_alert.statement: The mission experienced an outage from 05:28:00 UTC to 18:22:00 UTC on July 24, 2024. All VIIRS processing was on hold, and data for the outage period were described as not recoverable until further notice. The retrieved page body does not add a later recovery narrative. The referenced datasets include VIIRS/NPP Active Fires 6-Min L2 Swath 375m V002. The page does not name July 25–29.

firms_readme.statement: DL_FIRE_M-C61 is MODIS Collection 6.1. fire_archive_M-C61 is described as standard-quality MCD14ML. fire_archive_SV-C2 is described as standard-quality VNP14IMGTML. fire_nrt_J1V-C2 is VJ114IMGDL and fire_nrt_J2V-C2 is VJ214IMGDL. The readme says standard-quality data are not yet available from FIRMS for NOAA-20 and NOAA-21. It does not define fire_archive_J1V-C2 or fire_archive_J2V-C2. A version field is described as distinguishing MODIS from VIIRS, not as an NRT-versus-standard flag. A request with no fire points is delivered as a header-only CSV.

viirs_snpp_c2.readme_statement: fire_archive_SV-C2 is standard-quality VNP14IMGTML, replacing NRT VNP14IMGTDL.
viirs_snpp_c2.independent_product_checked: VNP14IMG Level-2 swath, not the FIRMS VNP14IMGTML table.

viirs_noaa20_c2.readme_statement: Only fire_nrt_J1V-C2 is defined, as VJ114IMGDL. Standard quality is stated as not yet available.

viirs_noaa21_c2.readme_statement: Only fire_nrt_J2V-C2 is defined, as VJ214IMGDL. Standard quality is stated as not yet available.
